title: Consumption Billing Based on Profile Values in the SAP System
raw_text:
9/29/26, 9:47 AM

Consumption Billing Based on Profile Values in the SAP System

Use

Within an advanced metering infrastructure, consumption profiles are managed in a meter data unification and synchronization
(MDUS) system.

You can import the profile values into the SAP system from the MDUS system for further processing in consumption billing. We
recommend that you use the time-of-use (TOU) interface for consumption billing, and the procedure described below uses the
TOU interface.

For more information about using the RTP interface, see RTP Billing.

Prerequisites
The business function Advanced Metering Infrastructure 2 (ISU_AMI_ 2) is active.
You are familiar with the basics of billing (see Contract Billing) and importing profile values (see Energy Data Management).

If you want to use the TOU interface for consumption billing based on profile values in the SAP system, you must select the
indicator Profile Can Be Billed with TOU Interface for these profiles.

The profiles must meet the following conditions:

e The profile category that belongs to the profile type is Elementary Profile.
e The interval length ID has the value 05, 10, 15, 30, or 60.
e The profile value category has the value Quantity or Demand.

e The profile is not allocated a replacement value procedure group.

e The profile is not allocated a consistency check group.
e The day offset has the value 00:00:00.

e The Cumulative Values indicator is not selected.

The profile values must have one of the following statuses:

e Value is valid (IUO12)

e Value was estimated (IU013)

e Value entered/changed manually (IUO15)
e Value was extrapolated (IUO20)

e Value was interpolated (IU021)

e Value manually changed externally (IUO22)

Billing Procedure
